skill.name: insforge-debug
skill.description: Diagnose InsForge backend failures and audit project health using CLI-guided checks for logs, metrics, database state, policies, metadata, and deployments.
skill.summary: Trace InsForge failures from symptoms to verified backend evidence.
skill.author: insforge

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown syntax, example URLs, relative documentation links, or authorized troubleshooting steps. Confirmed risks involve unpinned CLI execution, privileged project inspection, infrastructure changes, and diagnostic data sent to InsForge services.

remediation.issue: The skill repeatedly runs an unversioned package through npx.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited InsForge CLI version and request confirmation before its first download or execution.

remediation.issue: AI-assisted diagnosis sends issue descriptions and project observations to a backend-side LLM.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the data destination, require consent, and remove credentials, personal data, and sensitive URLs before submission.

remediation.issue: The feedback workflow can submit verbatim errors and reproduction details.
remediation.suggestion: Show a submission preview, require explicit approval, and strengthen redaction beyond pattern matching.

remediation.issue: Service-role queries and instance resizing can expose data or change billing and availability.
remediation.suggestion: Limit query columns and rows, verify authorization, and preserve mandatory approval for every infrastructure change.

content.value_statement: InsForge failures can span logs, database state, policies, metrics, and deployments. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through evidence-based diagnosis.
actual_capabilities: Routes SDK errors and HTTP status codes to the relevant InsForge diagnostic source.
Guides log inspection across API, Postgres, authentication, function, and deployment sources.
Checks database connections, locks, slow queries, indexes, bloat, size, and cache health.
Reviews RLS policies, project metadata, resource metrics, and advisor findings.
Investigates frontend and edge function deployment state with InsForge CLI commands.
Provides symptom-specific workflows for outages, timeouts, authentication, rate limits, and realtime failures.
limitations: Requires an accessible InsForge project, local Node.js tooling, and permission to run the InsForge CLI.
Some diagnostics require InsForge Platform login and do not work with API-key project links.
Logs and database checks are snapshots with retention and timing limits.
AI-assisted diagnoses are hypotheses and require verification against direct observations.

use_cases.title: Trace an API Failure
use_cases.description: Map an SDK error or HTTP status to logs, database checks, policies, or metadata.

use_cases.title: Investigate an Active Incident
use_cases.description: Correlate resource pressure, gateway timeouts, database health, and service logs during an outage.

use_cases.title: Run a Pre-Launch Audit
use_cases.description: Review advisor findings, RLS coverage, auth settings, storage exposure, and performance indicators before release.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose an Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this InsForge error: {error_message}. Identify the best evidence source, inspect it, and explain the likely cause.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has one concrete error message.

prompt_templates.title: Trace an Access Denial
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate this InsForge access issue: {request_details}. Compare logs, RLS policies, metadata, and expected user claims before proposing a fix.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer sees a 403 response or an unexpected empty result.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze an Incident
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate {incident_window} for widespread InsForge latency or gateway failures. Correlate metrics, database health, logs, and platform incident evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: An operator needs evidence during an active outage.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Launch Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this InsForge project before launch. Prioritize critical advisor findings, then verify security, RLS, performance, health, metadata, and unresolved risks.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced reviewer needs a structured readiness assessment.

output_examples.input: A database request returns 403 for an authenticated user.
output: Primary route: inspect the PostgREST logs at the failure time.
Verify the table policy role, USING expression, and WITH CHECK expression.
Confirm that the configured JWT claim matches the policy helper.

output_examples.input: Several unrelated endpoints return intermittent 504 errors.
output_examples.output: The failures span subsystems, so check the platform incident report and correlate Postgres recovery events with the timeout window before concluding OOM.

output_examples.input: A frontend deployment reports an error.
output: Find the failed deployment and inspect its status metadata.
Reproduce the build locally to obtain detailed output.
Compare required environment variable keys with the deployment metadata.

best_practices: Start with the smallest diagnostic source that matches the observed symptom.
Verify AI suggestions against logs, metrics, policies, metadata, or database state.
Obtain explicit approval before commands that deploy, resize, modify data, or change billing.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a single metric value as a root cause without trend and log correlation.
Do not paste credentials, personal data, or unrestricted production logs into AI or feedback commands.
Do not run service-role queries or infrastructure changes without confirming scope and authorization.

faq.question: What problems can this skill diagnose?
faq.answer: It covers API errors, authentication failures, RLS denials, slow queries, outages, rate limits, realtime issues, and deployment failures.

faq.question: Does it modify my InsForge project?
faq.answer: Most steps are read-only, but some recipes mention deployments, database queries, or instance resizing. Review and approve those commands separately.

faq.question: Is InsForge Platform login required?
faq.answer: Some advisor and incident diagnostics require Platform login. Several logs, metadata, policy, and database checks may work through other project links.

faq.question: Can I trust the AI-assisted diagnosis?
faq.answer: Treat it as a starting hypothesis. Confirm each claim with the direct diagnostic sources named in the response.

faq.question: Why might a slow query check return nothing?
faq.answer: The check only captures queries running longer than five seconds at that moment. Use advisor data or logs for historical evidence.

faq.question: How should sensitive data be handled?
faq.answer: Remove secrets and personal data before AI or feedback commands. Keep log queries narrow and avoid unnecessary service-role access.
